notes_zh: - **优化** 快捷面板的底色、边线和投影：深色模式下更沉，浅色模式下更亮，两种外观都能透出一点背后的内容
notes_en: - **Improve** Quick panel background, hairline and shadow: deeper in dark mode, brighter in light mode, with a hint of the content behind showing through in both

beta.notes_zh:
- **新增** 快捷指令和 Spotlight 里可以使用 PasteMemo：打开快捷面板、搜索剪贴板历史、获取最近的条目、用规则处理文本
- **新增** 规则可以使用 ⌘K 里的提取、识别、打开和接力功能，也能删除原条目、播放提示音
- **新增** 13 个规则文本工具：JSON 格式化 / 压缩、Base64 编解码、驼峰 / 下划线命名、全角半角互转、简体转繁体、按行去重 / 排序 / 合并、去掉 HTML 标签
- **新增** 规则条件：粘贴到的应用、字数、行数、是否置顶、是否敏感、所在分组、时间段、星期；每个条件都可以设为「不满足」
- **新增** 规则结果可以存到文件夹或发到 Webhook
- **新增** 敏感条目可以单独设置保留时长
- **优化** 「添加条件」菜单按内容、应用、条目状态、时间分组
- **修复** 系统自动填充短信验证码时，这条验证码有时被记成前台 App 复制的，没有短信原文
beta.notes_en:
- **New** PasteMemo actions in Shortcuts and Spotlight: open the Quick Panel, search clipboard history, get a recent clip, process text with a rule
- **New** Rules can use the extract, recognize, open and relay features from ⌘K, and can also delete the original clip or play a sound
- **New** 13 text tools for rules: format / minify JSON, Base64 encode / decode, camelCase / snake_case, full-width ⇄ half-width, Simplified to Traditional Chinese, dedupe / sort / join lines, strip HTML tags
- **New** Rule conditions: target app, character count, line count, pinned, sensitive, group, time of day, day of week; any condition can be set to "Not met"
- **New** Rule results can be saved to a folder or sent to a webhook
- **New** Sensitive clips can have their own retention period
- **Improve** The "Add Condition" menu is grouped into Content, Apps, Clip State and Time
- **Fix** When macOS autofilled an SMS verification code, the code was sometimes recorded as copied from the front app, without the message text
